title: The Week That Outlives the 14-Day Window
description: GitHub keeps repository traffic in a rolling 14-day window and then the numbers are gone. OrchestKit #4071 adds a Monday 06:00 UTC workflow that folds the previous full week into one JSONL row and opens a PR carrying it to docs/traffic/snapshots.jsonl, fail-closed: any failed endpoint read or an empty measurement week writes nothing, so an absent week means a failed run, never a zero row. Flip endpoint failures on and watch the run refuse; pick any of the 36 public skills and read its exact credit line; browse the drafts-only seeding list.
